final_criterion.internal_finding: The student's modal logic formula correctly expresses the intended spatial constraint. The formula uses the 'dia' operator to ensure that if a cell contains filling, then there exists some cell reachable via 'oneabove' where both bread and every deeper cell is not bread. This aligns with the requirement that bread must not occur more than one row below a state containing filling.

evidence.excerpt:
implies(
            filling,
            dia( oneabove,                          % jump to the cell 1 row below
                 and( bread,                        % that cell is bread
                      box( above, not(bread) ) ) )  % every deeper cell is NOT bread
        )
